name: Ezer
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: The sons of Ephraim are traced, and Ezer and Elead are named, whom the men of Gath slew when they came down to take their cattle.

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
